title: Green Expectations: Climate Change and Homeowner Valuation of Dwelling Sustainability
abstract: I estimate climate discount rates by calibrating the present value of expected energy savings from greener dwellings to the corresponding price premium. I link seven million residential real estate transactions in the United Kingdom to the sustainability ratings of the underlying dwellings and demonstrate that homeowners price dwelling sustainability following economic principles. Homeowners apply lower rates to discount marginal energy savings from subsequently greener dwellings. Differences in capital constraints, heterogeneity in climate beliefs, regulatory uncertainty associated with lower-rated dwellings, and uncertainty of marginal savings from lower-rated dwellings do not explain the declining cross-sectional structure of the discount rates with increasing dwelling sustainability. Thus, homeowners derive non-pecuniary benefits from holding greener dwellings, and these benefits become more salient with increasing dwelling sustainability.  This interpretation is supported by the increase in unprofitable investments to have ratings improved for dwellings not impacted by the regulation imposing a minimum energy efficiency standard.
abstract_zh: 我通过校准绿色住宅预期节能收益的现值与相应的价格溢价，估计了气候折现率。我将英国700万笔住宅房地产交易与标的住宅的可持续性评级相联系，并证明业主对住宅可持续性的定价遵循经济学原理。业主对于更绿色住宅所带来的边际节能收益，适用较低的折现率。资本约束的差异、气候信念的异质性、低评级住宅相关的监管不确定性，以及低评级住宅边际节能收益的不确定性，都无法解释随住宅可持续性提高而呈现的折现率横截面下降结构。因此，业主从持有更绿色的住宅中获得了非金钱性收益，而且随着住宅可持续性的提高，这些收益变得更加突出。这一解释得到了如下事实的支持：对于未受最低能效标准监管影响的住宅，为提升其评级而进行的不盈利投资有所增加。

title: Legislator Tweets About the Green Transition and the Returns of Green vs. Brown Stocks
abstract: To study the impact of green-transition regulation on firm value, we analyse stock returns around legislator tweets about climate change. Green stocks significantly outperform brown stocks in the one-to-ten-minute window around pro-transition tweets. The cumulative daily-average green-minus-brown portfolio return around pro-transition tweets is 6.9% higher than around anti-transition ones. For tweets that mention environmental regulations, the spread increases in the weeks before a congressional vote and is stronger before close votes and when Congress is split. Our findings suggest that the green transition impacts the relative performance of green and brown stocks, at least partly, via a regulatory channel.
abstract_zh: 为研究绿色转型监管对企业价值的影响，我们分析了立法者关于气候变化的推文前后的股票收益。在支持转型的推文前后1至10分钟的时间窗口内，绿色股票显著跑赢棕色股票。支持转型的推文前后，绿色减棕色投资组合的日均累积收益，比反对转型的推文前后高出6.9%。对于提及环境监管的推文，这一差距在国会投票前的几周内扩大，并且在接近票数相当的投票前以及国会分裂时更为明显。我们的研究结果表明，绿色转型至少部分地通过监管渠道，影响绿色股票与棕色股票的相对表现。
